# Creating publication-ready figures

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Tips and workflows for creating publication-quality figures.

## Key principles

- Use consistent color schemes
- Add meaningful titles and labels
- Check colorblind accessibility
- Use appropriate figure dimensions

## Example workflow

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Define colors
colors <- c("0" = "#E63946",
            "1" = "#F1FAEE")

# Check colorblind safety
SCpubr::do_ColorBlindCheck(colors = colors)

# Create figure
p <- SCpubr::do_DimPlot(sample = sample,
                        colors.use = colors,
                        plot.title = "Cell Clusters")
p
```
